reason: I already tried a budget app and quit after a few weeks because I could not keep up with the entering. This one is better because it reads the slips for me, but it still needs me to remember to scan every slip every day, and I know I will forget. 69 baht is not much, but I would be paying for something I already know I will stop using.
objection: I'll forget to scan the slips every day, and then the app is empty again like the last one.
would_change_my_mind: Something that catches my slips automatically without me having to remember, or a reminder that only costs me a few seconds a day.
